I was waiting to collect something, as I noted Michelle take over a phone call from a younger receptionist, it appeared to be a difficult phone call.
I moved away and took a seat.
I couldn’t hear the caller, but from the time it took, and response by Michelle, I could tell that it took a lot of patience and calmness.
There was a lot of warmth and empathy, and when Michelle finished, she introduced me to the younger new receptionist.
I said to her take it from me you are learning from one of the best, and from what i observed, that was a master class in customer service.
I think we forget that the front line staff in any medical centre, whether it is on the phone or face to face, do an extremely good job, and are faced with a lot of difficulties along the way, and are blamed constantly for things that are beyond their control.
I know the Limes staff well, and they are all really hardworking and caring individuals.
